body:
接这单（hunt30 审计车道）。已在 main@7597c132 上核实根因：`desktopTurn` 的 `small(body)` 只看 `max_tokens <= 4096`，Desktop 的健康探测（max_tokens 1、无 tools、claude 形模型名）被当标题请求，带去 `claude-desktop.model` 里的旧会话模型，404。修法照报告里说的正向识别 `desktopTitle(body)`，`byClaudeCode` 参数随之冗余移除。补丁稍后贴在本 issue，分支：`hunt30-desktop-title`（fork ggbdpq/magpie）。

Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode)

照报告的根因修了，红绿与消融都在 main@7597c132 上做过：

- `desktopTurn` 不再拿 `max_tokens <= 4096` 当标题（`small`），改用 `desktopTitle(body)` 的正向识别：标题 prompt 的两种形状（Desktop 自有客户端的字符串 system、Claude Code `--system-prompt` 的 text block）都已在 `desktopTitle` 里。其余无 tools 的请求一律保留自己点名的模型——Claude Code 的分类器本来就是这个行为（#1539），Desktop 的探测现在也是。`byClaudeCode` 参数因此冗余，随补丁移除；`small()` 保留（observe.go 还在用）。
- 回归 `TestDesktopProbeKeepsItsModel`：探测打在被服务的模型上、`claude-desktop.model` 里留着已关供应商的 pick——修前 404（"Any is switched off in Magpie, so \"fake/claude-sonnet-5\" is not served; switch it on again…"，与报告同形），修后探测用自己的模型、不写 pick；标题仍跟随会话 pick。

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 修前红（7597c132） | 404 "Any is switched off in Magpie, so \"fake/claude-sonnet-5\" is not served…" |
| 修后同测试 | 绿 |
| 消融（checkout 910522a7~1 的 desktop.go / gateway.go / desktop_turn_test.go，仅追加新测试） | 回红，同上形状 |
| TestDesktop* / TestClaudeDesktop* / TestHasTools（-tags nogui -p 2） | ok |
| go test ./internal/gateway 全量（-tags nogui -p 2 -timeout 45m） | ok，303.5s |
| gofmt -l internal/ | 干净 |
| go vet ./...（darwin / GOOS=linux -tags nogui / GOOS=windows） | 干净（trayimage_darwin 的 cgo -Wenum-conversion 警告为本机已知环境噪音） |
| go build（darwin / linux nogui / windows） | ok |

补丁与分支：[ggbdpq/magpie 分支 `hunt30-desktop-title`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt30-desktop-title)（基于 7597c132，提交 910522a7）。

没跑的：GUI 套件（改动不触 GUI）；真实 Claude Desktop 的 Credentials Test（探测体按报告的 JSON 在 httptest 全链路复现）；Desktop 的分支名请求（注释说与标题同一 prompt，`desktopTitle` 一并覆盖，无独立 fixture）；gateway 之外的包测试（三平台 vet/build 全仓过）。

合入请保留原作者或加 `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>`。

From 910522a70b1633412cc8daf5edf3aebfb967b65e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:58:31 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] gateway: Desktop's one-token probe keeps the model it names
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Claude Desktop probes the gateway it is given before saving its
credentials: a one-token request, no tools, a model from /v1/models.
desktopTurn judged a tool-less request a session title by max_tokens
alone (small: at most 4096), so the probe went to the session's pick —
one a previous session left on a provider since switched off, and the
test came back "… is switched off in Magpie, so … is not served" naming
that provider, however healthy the model the probe asked for (#2473,
EchoTint). Models discovery answered fine, which made it look like the
credentials were at fault.

What changed:
- desktop.go: a title is the request whose system prompt is Desktop's
  title prompt (desktopTitle), whoever sent it — Desktop's own client,
  or Claude Code's `claude -p --system-prompt …` for it. Every other
  tool-less request keeps the model it names: Claude Code's classifiers
  did already (#1539), and now Desktop's probe does too. The
  byClaudeCode parameter said which of the two shapes to check and is
  gone; small stays for observe.go's kind.
- desktop_turn_test.go: TestDesktopProbeKeepsItsModel — the probe on a
  served model keeps it while a switched-off provider's pick stands
  (red on 7597c132e: 404 "Any is switched off in Magpie, so …"), the
  pick file survives it, and a title still follows the pick.

Run: GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go test -tags nogui -p 2 -count=1 over the
desktop family (TestDesktop*, TestClaudeDesktop*, TestHasTools): ok.
gofmt -l: clean. Three-platform vet and build below, with the issue.

Reproduced the stale-provider part of this issue on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2.

In this case provider A was still enabled globally, but Claude Desktop had been restricted to provider B. `GET /v1/models` correctly listed only B. `claude-desktop.model` still contained an A model, and the Desktop startup probe for B's Haiku alias was sent to A's Opus model. The returned 502 named A. The gateway usage record confirmed `req=B/claude-haiku-5-5`, `provider=A`, `model=claude-opus-5-5`.

The caller was Claude Desktop and the probe body was:

```json
{"model":"<B's Haiku alias>","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"."}]}
```

So validation against the globally enabled providers alone is not sufficient: a cached pick can also be outside the current Desktop-visible catalog. An explicit connection probe should retain its selected provider/model and should not mutate the session's pick. This supports the positive title-prompt identification fix proposed above.

Separately, this environment also has a credential-specific upstream refusal of raw HTTP probes. Replaying that same minimal request directly to the configured upstream, bypassing Magpie, returns 429, while a genuine Claude Code invocation through the identical proxy and credential succeeds. That is a separate compatibility problem, not evidence that the stale-provider routing fix failed. No credentials, prompts from real work, proxy authentication details, or account identifiers are included here.

Gentle nudge on this one — no rush. The fix (branch `hunt30-desktop-title`, head 910522a7) still applies cleanly to current main. Since it was posted, SivanCola reproduced the stale-provider half of the report on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2, which lands right on the behavior this addresses: the title probe went to a provider a previous session had left behind instead of the model it was asked about, so `desktopTurn` now recognizes the title prompt by its shape instead of trusting `max_tokens`. Happy to adjust if anything is missing.

Nudged with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode).

Published a fix in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/9fd7a9d4c087d3c0f4caac1ff3d27a8350577744

Thanks to @ggbdpq for the diagnosis and posted fix above, credited as co-author. Desktop titles now use the existing positive system-prompt check (`desktopTitle`) for both Electron and Claude Code. A small max_tokens alone no longer reroutes a credential probe to the saved session model. The unused client-kind argument is removed from desktopTurn and all callers, and the routing reference documents the contract.

The HTTP regression is adapted from the posted fixture and covers the old provider both on and off, with streaming and non-streaming probes. It checks the requested model reaches the local backend and that the saved pick remains unchanged; a title control still follows the session pick. On the old product code the streaming cases fail with the same stale-provider 404 (off) and an attempted connection to that provider (on, 502). Fixed Desktop/ClaudeDesktop/HasTools tests pass under `-race -count=5`.

At this exact head, all seven acceptance commands passed with Go1.26.8, isolated HOME and pinned caches: native Linux vet/build, Linux nogui vet/build, Windows vet/build, and `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` (69 packages). Gofmt and whitespace checks are clean.

Combined branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-20261023-t

Not checked: real Claude Desktop's credential dialog, a live provider, macOS/Windows runtime, or the Desktop-visible-catalog restriction itself. The fixture uses the reported probe shape and existing test backend; it does not simulate the separate upstream raw-probe refusal. No live gateway/config changed and no upstream PR opened.
